propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria through multiple seams, allowing project disables to be ignored and inconsistent repository policy states to be observed across separate reads
A single immutable CriteriaSnapshot compiled at operation time must serve as the one authoritative source of effective built-in, project LLM, and project DET criteria for all consumers

Code-review project LLM criteria must validate applies_to as a non-empty list of repository-relative globs, with ["**"] as the explicit repository-wide spelling that selects unconditionally even when changed_files is empty
Non-matching scoped globs must produce typed non-applicable selection reasons without executing criteria, and the empty-changed_files case must preserve prior ungated behavior

The shared _validate_applies_to validator must remain empty-list-legal for plan-review project criteria and other gates, with the stricter non-empty-glob rule applied only to code-review project LLM criteria at snapshot compile time
